# Studies: math transforms and operators

These registry studies are not callable as `ta.*`: the language has no `ta.<id>` for the family. Use `math.*` or an operator (see the studies skill).

`acos`, `add`, `asin`, `atan`, `ceil`, `cos`, `cosh`, `div`, `exp`, `floor`, `ln`, `log10`, `max`, `maxindex`, `min`, `minindex`, `minmax`, `minmaxindex`, `mult`, `sin`, `sinh`, `sqrt`, `sub`, `sum`, `tan`, `tanh`
